summary: Frontend-only verification of the revamped glass-styled /checkout page. Authenticated as testpro@test.com via cookie session, then exercised pro_yearly+3 seats, essential_monthly+1 seat, back-btn navigation, and 1920x800 layout. All scenarios pass: glass order-summary renders correctly with white circle ticks, Stripe Embedded Checkout iframe (js.stripe.com) mounts in data-testid='embedded-checkout-wrapper', back-btn navigates to /choose-plan, side-by-side layout has no overlap, and the page background is the expected dark #050507.

issues: Two-column grid uses items-center: when Stripe iframe is ~1124px tall and the left order-summary card is ~400px, the left card is vertically centered creating large empty space above/below it. Consider items-start to align card tops at desktop heights for a tighter look. Not a bug, purely cosmetic.

Stripe's embedded card header is bright indigo/violet (Stripe-owned UI, not controllable) — visually contrasts with the rest of the dark glass aesthetic. Acceptable per requirements (Stripe iframe must stay on a clean light card).

critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.js fetchClientSecret throws on non-ok response but has no UI error state — EmbeddedCheckoutProvider will surface its own error, but consider catching to show a friendlier toast.

Two 401 errors logged in the console on initial /checkout navigation (before cookie hydration completed) — harmless since AuthContext re-fetches and the page renders, but could be cleaned up by gating render on auth-resolved state to avoid noisy console errors.
test_credentials: testpro@test.com / password (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). trial_end is in the past, so checkout shows 'No trial remaining / Charged today' branch as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Glass Checkout revamp verified end-to-end via Playwright. Stripe iframe mounts correctly (verified iframe src starts with https://js.stripe.com/v3/embedded-checkout-inner-...). For future tests of /checkout, authenticate via POST /api/auth/login with credentials:'include' then page.goto(/checkout?...) — this avoids redirect to landing. Screenshots captured at /app/test_reports/checkout_pro_yearly_3.png and /app/test_reports/checkout_layout_1920x800.png.

Stripe iframe mounted on both URLs (src=https://js.stripe.com/v3/embedded-checkout-inner-...) — PASS
